claim: A JNext mem/ram.bin dump is physical SRAM with a 0x40000 offset before ordinary Next RAM and dedicated bank 5 video RAM; rebuild CPU memory through the MMU, never from raw file offsets.
limit: Notes do not say whether the CSpect physical-read mismatch also holds.

evidence.text: ram.bin includes a 0x40000 offset before ordinary Next RAM; asserting the hook-code signature first showed an all-zero free-pool count was the wrong offset.
Ordinary RAM pages have a physical SRAM offset; reconstruct CPU RAM through the MMU and dedicated bank 5 VRAM, not raw offsets.
Physical SRAM includes a 040000 aperture offset.
